verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Bland has an analytics layer (MCP server can 'query analytics') and quality-grading tools like Evals (LLM judges scoring call dimensions) and a testbed for reviewing call interactions, implying some built-in metrics exist. However, there is no direct evidence of an actual dashboard UI showing success rates, call durations, outcomes, or sentiment trends over time — analytics access shown is via MCP/API query rather than a visual dashboard. Missing for 10: screenshots or docs of a native analytics dashboard, explicit mention of success-rate/duration/sentiment metrics, and independent confirmation the dashboard requires no custom building.
